definitions.explanation: The place where something happens or happened.
The place where actual work is done.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}{現場|げんば}に{駆|か}けつけた。
examples.english: I rushed to the scene of the accident.

examples.japanese: {現場|げんば}の{声|こえ}を{聞|き}く。
examples.english: To listen to voices from the field.

notes:
{現場|げんば} is the actual location or site.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {現場|げんば}に{行|い}く (to go to the scene)
- {現場|げんば}{検証|けんしょう} (on-site investigation)
- {現場|げんば}{監督|かんとく} (site supervisor)

TYPES:
- {事故|じこ}/{事件|じけん}{現場|げんば} (accident/crime scene)
- {工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば} (construction site)
- {撮影|さつえい}{現場|げんば} (filming location)
